_about: Digits for the memory trainers (/memory/challenges/pi/). 'digits' starts with the whole-number part (3 or 2), then the decimals. sha256 is of the 'digits' string; scripts/memory/test-memory.js recomputes the digits and checks it. Checked 2026-10-30.

pi.name: pi
pi.label: π (pi)

sources.name: MacTutor History of Mathematics, University of St Andrews: 1000 places of π
University of Michigan course page: the first 1000 digits of pi
Cuemath: What are 1000 digits of pi?

pi.note: All 1,000 decimal places match MacTutor and an independent computation (Machin's formula). The Michigan page agrees through decimal 998 (it rounds its last digit), and Cuemath agrees through the first 929 decimals as fetched.
